item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":40,"statement":"Plain evaluation cannot support a required `trace` parameter: `Evaluate.__call__` sends each example through its worker function and calls the metric as `metric(example, prediction)` with only two arguments, so a trace-dependent metric should fail there.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"Few-shot bootstrapping can use the same trace-dependent metric because `_bootstrap_one_example` runs the teacher inside `dspy.context(trace=[])`, captures `dspy.settings.trace`, and calls the metric as `self.metric(example, prediction, trace)`; the bootstrap path explicitly needs per-example traces rather than `Evaluate`.","span_ids":["s2","s3"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"On a successful bootstrap, each recorded trace step is converted into an augmented demo and `_train()` assigns those demos to the student's predictor(s). In a minimal one-predictor setup with `max_bootstrapped_demos=1`, that supports asserting that exactly one demo was added.","span_ids":["s4","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"After `compile()` finishes, it marks the returned student with `_compiled = True`, so the repro can use that as a direct assertion that the bootstrap path completed successfully.","span_ids":["s6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/evaluate/evaluate.py","start_line":162,"end_line":175},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":187,"end_line":207},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":178,"end_line":180},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":223,"end_line":255},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":259,"end_line":270},{"span_id":"s6","path":"dspy/teleprompt/bootstrap.py","start_line":84,"end_line":94}]}
